title: Painting Dappled Light
content: In this new video I share insights about how to paint dappled light.(Link to YouTube)I demonstrate a few insights about dappled light as I create a gouache sketch of the Jean Hasbrouck House in New Paltz.Here's an example in oil, about 8 x 10.Video Tutorials"GRADIENTS: Color, Form, Illusion."“How to Make a Sketch Easel”"Gouache in the Wild"MaterialsTitanium white (gouache)Azo yellow (gouache)Terra rosa (watercolor)Cerulean blue deep (watercolor)
